visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide high-angle pan of a crowded cafe interior. Customers are seated at wooden tables, eating and talking. The walls feature a grey brick pattern, and the lighting is warm and recessed. (2) A female server's hands are seen placing a wooden tray of food onto a table. The tray contains a white teapot, bowls of side dishes, and a main dish of shrimp over rice. (3) Close-up shot. A hand holds a white teapot and pours clear broth over a bowl filled with large, peeled red shrimp and white rice. Green herbs and mushrooms are visible in the bowl. (4) Chopsticks lift several large cooked shrimp from the bowl. Another shot shows chopsticks picking up a piece of abalone topped with orange salmon roe over white rice. (5) Close-up of a breakfast/brunch platter. A hand pours dressing from a small glass pitcher over a green salad. The plate also contains a golden-brown croissant, scrambled eggs, and pork ribs coated in a green nut sauce. (6) A close-up of a plate of stir-fried spicy shrimp with leafy green herbs and pieces of what looks like king oyster mushrooms. (7) Close-up of a mango soufflé pancake. A knife cuts through the fluffy yellow cake, which is topped with thick cream, mango cubes, and pink accents. A small logo pick is visible. (8) Focus on two specialty drinks. One is a green matcha latte with a white foam bear on top; the other is a brown bubble tea with a Shiba Inu-shaped marshmallow floating in the foam. (9) The video pans across the cafe interior again, showing several groups of customers seated in booth-like areas with white circular pillows. (10) Final exterior shot of a cafe storefront. A large text overlay lists the addresses of three different branches.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional food vlog designed to attract customers to 'Good Partner' cafe in Kaohsiung. It uses high-energy narration, fast-paced editing, and close-up 'food porn' shots of specific menu items (shrimp rice, ribs, mango soufflé, animal foam art) to build an appetizing and trendy image of the establishment.
